about: Renders two lists and the controls that move checked rows between them, for a set a person builds out of a longer one.

described.about: Rows with a second line from `description`, with Lantern moved on first render by `defaultValue`. A side keeps room for every row, and a side whose rows have a second line grows past that floor.
described.title: Rows with a second line

held.about: The page controls the set with `value` and `onValueChange`, and lists it under the transfer. The transfer keeps the checked rows on each side as its own state.
held.title: A set the page controls

palette.about: Every palette. The first row is checked, so its checkbox shows the palette.
palette.title: Palettes

size.about: Every size. A control is disabled while no row on its side is checked, and both sides keep room for every row, so the layout does not move as rows cross. The size sets the gap between the parts and the size of the controls.
size.title: Sizes

title: Transfer
